paragraphs.text: The Magic: The Gathering Deck Deconstruction Companion reprints deck construction articles from The Duelist with updates to cards available at the time. It was written by Beth Moursund , a contributor to The Duelist . It was published by Wizards of the Coast on February 3, 1999.
The official guide to deckbuilding is here! This volume offers a definitive collection of deck lists for every type of player of Magic: The Gathering , the world's most popular trading card game.
